CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_tenant_hidden_ids_core(p_entity_type text)
 RETURNS TABLE(entity_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_entity_type IS NULL OR p_entity_type NOT IN ('produto','microrganismo','cultura') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_invalid_payload' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('read_prefs');
  RETURN QUERY SELECT COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id,v.cultura_id) FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility v
   WHERE v.organization_id=v_org AND v.entity_type=p_entity_type AND v.hidden
   ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 301; -- cliente rejeita >300 de forma explícita
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_tenant_read_visibility_core(p_entity_type text, p_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(entity_id uuid, hidden boolean, version integer, updated_at timestamp with time zone)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_entity_type IS NULL OR p_entity_type NOT IN ('produto','microrganismo','cultura') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_invalid_payload' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor(CASE WHEN p_entity_type='cultura' THEN 'read_management' ELSE 'read_catalog' END);
  IF p_ids IS NULL OR cardinality(p_ids) > 500 OR array_position(p_ids, NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_invalid_payload' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY SELECT COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id,v.cultura_id), v.hidden, v.version, v.updated_at
    FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility v
   WHERE v.organization_id=v_org AND v.entity_type=p_entity_type
     AND COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id,v.cultura_id) = ANY(p_ids);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_tenant_selection_core(p_entity_type text, p_search text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer, p_include_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, nome text, ativo boolean, hidden boolean, selectable boolean, in_page boolean, total bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid; v_q text := NULLIF(btrim(COALESCE(p_search,'')),'');
BEGIN
  IF p_entity_type IS NULL OR p_entity_type NOT IN ('produto','microrganismo','cultura')
     OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
     OR (v_q IS NOT NULL AND char_length(v_q) > 80)
     OR (p_include_ids IS NOT NULL AND (cardinality(p_include_ids) > 50 OR array_position(p_include_ids, NULL) IS NOT NULL)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_invalid_payload' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
  v_org := platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor(CASE WHEN p_entity_type='cultura' THEN 'read_selection_cultura' ELSE 'read_catalog' END);
  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT p.id, p.nome::text AS nome, p.ativo FROM public.produtos p WHERE p_entity_type='produto'
    UNION ALL SELECT m.id, m.nome::text, m.ativo FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE p_entity_type='microrganismo'
    UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.nome::text, c.ativo FROM public.culturas c WHERE p_entity_type='cultura'
  ), marked AS (
    SELECT b.*, COALESCE(v.hidden,false) AS hidden FROM base b
      LEFT JOIN public.catalog_tenant_visibility v ON v.organization_id=v_org AND v.entity_type=p_entity_type
       AND COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id,v.cultura_id)=b.id
  ), page AS (
    SELECT m.*, count(*) OVER () AS total FROM marked m
     WHERE m.ativo IS TRUE AND m.hidden IS FALSE
       AND (v_q IS NULL OR m.nome ILIKE '%' || replace(replace(replace(v_q,'\','\\'),'%','\%'),'_','\_') || '%')
     ORDER BY m.nome, m.id LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset
  )
  SELECT pg.id, pg.nome, pg.ativo, pg.hidden, true, true, pg.total FROM page pg
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.id, m.nome, m.ativo, m.hidden, (m.ativo IS TRUE AND m.hidden IS FALSE), false, NULL::bigint FROM marked m
   WHERE p_include_ids IS NOT NULL AND m.id = ANY(p_include_ids) AND m.id NOT IN (SELECT pg2.id FROM page pg2);
END; $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_volume_assert_row(p_id uuid, p_tipo text, p_item uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE r public.catalogo_volumes%ROWTYPE;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO r FROM public.catalogo_volumes WHERE id=p_id;
  IF NOT FOUND OR r.item_tipo IS DISTINCT FROM p_tipo OR COALESCE(r.produto_id,r.microrganismo_id) IS DISTINCT FROM p_item
    OR r.moeda IS DISTINCT FROM 'BRL'
    OR r.preco_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.round(r.preco_brl/(r.volume_ml/1000.0),2)
    OR r.valor_dose_100ml_brl IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.round(r.preco_litro_brl/10.0,2)
    OR r.doses_por_volume IS DISTINCT FROM pg_catalog.round(r.volume_ml/100.0,4) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='40001', MESSAGE='catalog_volume_confirmation_failed'; END IF;
  -- Duplicidade: no máximo uma apresentação ATIVA por pai e volume.
  IF r.ativo AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.catalogo_volumes o WHERE o.id<>r.id AND o.ativo AND o.volume_ml=r.volume_ml
      AND o.item_tipo=r.item_tipo AND o.produto_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.produto_id AND o.microrganismo_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.microrganismo_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='23505', MESSAGE='catalog_volume_duplicate'; END IF;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_volume_preview_token(p_actor uuid, p_operation text, p_id uuid, p_change jsonb, p_reason text, p_row_version timestamp with time zone, p_tipo text, p_item uuid, p_parent jsonb)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT pg_catalog.encode(pg_catalog.sha256(pg_catalog.convert_to(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'v',1,'actor',p_actor,'operation',p_operation,'id',p_id,'change',p_change,'reason',pg_catalog.btrim(p_reason),
    'row_version',p_row_version,'parent',p_parent,
    'siblings',(SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_array(o.id,o.updated_at,o.ativo,o.volume_ml::text,o.preco_brl::text)
        ORDER BY o.id),'[]'::jsonb)
      FROM public.catalogo_volumes o WHERE o.item_tipo=p_tipo AND COALESCE(o.produto_id,o.microrganismo_id)=p_item AND o.id<>p_id)
  )::text,'UTF8')),'hex');
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.catalog_volume_row(p_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',v.id,'item_tipo',v.item_tipo,'item_id',COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id),
    'volume_ml',v.volume_ml::text,'rotulo',v.rotulo,'preco_brl',v.preco_brl::text,'moeda',v.moeda,'ativo',v.ativo,'ordem',v.ordem,
    'preco_litro_brl',v.preco_litro_brl::text,'valor_dose_100ml_brl',v.valor_dose_100ml_brl::text,'doses_por_volume',v.doses_por_volume::text,
    'updated_at',v.updated_at)
  FROM public.catalogo_volumes v WHERE v.id=p_id;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.lab_assert_manufacturable(p_product_id uuid, p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT platform_private.lab_item_is_manufacturable(p_product_id,p_microorganism_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'LAB_ITEM_NOT_MANUFACTURABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514',
      HINT='Somente produtos biológicos e microrganismos podem gerar fabricação laboratorial.';
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.lab_item_is_manufacturable(p_product_id uuid, p_microorganism_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    -- Duas referências na mesma linha são ambíguas e falham fechadas. Isso impede que
    -- um microrganismo válido transforme produto químico/fertilizante em fabricável.
    WHEN p_product_id IS NOT NULL AND p_microorganism_id IS NOT NULL THEN false
    WHEN p_product_id IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.produtos p WHERE p.id=p_product_id AND p.familia_catalogo='biologico')
    WHEN p_microorganism_id IS NOT NULL THEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.microrganismos m WHERE m.id=p_microorganism_id)
    ELSE false END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.read_global_item_volumes_core(p_item_tipo text, p_item_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_offset integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_parent jsonb; v_items jsonb; v_more boolean;
BEGIN
  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 10000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_volume_invalid'; END IF;
  v_parent:=platform_private.catalog_volume_parent(p_item_tipo,p_item_id,false);
  WITH page AS (
    SELECT v.id, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY v.ordem, v.volume_ml, v.id) rn FROM public.catalogo_volumes v
     WHERE v.item_tipo=p_item_tipo AND COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id)=p_item_id
     ORDER BY v.ordem, v.volume_ml, v.id LIMIT p_limit+1 OFFSET p_offset)
  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(platform_private.catalog_volume_row(id) ORDER BY rn) FILTER (WHERE rn<=p_offset+p_limit),'[]'::jsonb),
         count(*)>p_limit
    INTO v_items, v_more FROM page;
  RETURN pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('item',pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('tipo',p_item_tipo,'id',p_item_id,'nome',v_parent->'nome',
      'codigo',v_parent->'codigo','ativo',v_parent->'ativo','pricing',platform_private.catalog_volume_pricing(v_parent) - 'updated_at'),
    'items',v_items,'has_more',v_more);
END;
$function$

 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_search text; v_items jsonb; v_count int;
BEGIN
  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
  IF p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 50 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 1000000
    OR p_only_active IS NULL OR pg_catalog.char_length(COALESCE(p_search,'')) > 120 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_micro_invalid';
  END IF;
  v_search:=pg_catalog.btrim(COALESCE(p_search,''));
  SELECT COALESCE(pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',m.id,'codigo',m.codigo,'nome',m.nome,'ativo',m.ativo)
    ORDER BY m.nome, m.id),'[]'::jsonb), count(*)
  INTO v_items, v_count FROM (
    SELECT id,codigo,nome,ativo FROM public.microrganismos
    WHERE (NOT p_only_active OR ativo IS TRUE)
      AND (v_search='' OR pg_catalog.strpos(pg_catalog.lower(nome),pg_catalog.lower(v_search))>0
        OR pg_catalog.strpos(pg_catalog.lower(COALESCE(codigo,'')),pg_catalog.lower(v_search))>0)
    ORDER BY nome, id LIMIT p_limit+1 OFFSET p_offset) m;
  -- has_more por sentinela (limit+1), itens cortados ao limite.
  RETURN pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('items',
    CASE WHEN v_count>p_limit THEN v_items - p_limit ELSE v_items END,'has_more',v_count>p_limit);
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.read_global_product_catalog_by_family_core(p_familia text, p_revisao text, p_search text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_search text; v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
  IF p_revisao IS NULL OR p_revisao NOT IN ('familia','todos','pendentes')
     OR (p_revisao = 'familia' AND (p_familia IS NULL OR p_familia NOT IN ('biologico','quimico','fertilizante_adubo')))
     OR (p_revisao <> 'familia' AND p_familia IS NOT NULL)
     OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 50
     OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset < 0 OR p_offset > 1000000
     OR p_search IS NULL OR pg_catalog.char_length(p_search) > 120 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='platform_catalog_invalid_query';
  END IF;
  v_search := pg_catalog.lower(pg_catalog.btrim(p_search));
  WITH bounded AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT p.id, p.codigo, p.nome, p.tipo, COALESCE(p.ativo,false) AS ativo, p.b2b_enabled, p.updated_at,
           p.familia_catalogo, p.classe_catalogo
    FROM public.produtos p
    WHERE ((p_revisao = 'familia' AND p.familia_catalogo IS NOT NULL AND p.familia_catalogo = p_familia)
        OR p_revisao = 'todos'
        OR (p_revisao = 'pendentes' AND p.familia_catalogo IS NULL))
      AND (v_search = ''
       OR pg_catalog.strpos(pg_catalog.lower(p.nome), v_search) > 0
       OR pg_catalog.strpos(pg_catalog.lower(COALESCE(p.codigo, '')), v_search) > 0)
    ORDER BY (p.familia_catalogo IS NULL) DESC, pg_catalog.lower(p.nome) COLLATE "C", p.id
    LIMIT (p_limit + 1) OFFSET p_offset
  ), page AS (
    SELECT * FROM bounded b ORDER BY (b.familia_catalogo IS NULL) DESC, pg_catalog.lower(b.nome) COLLATE "C", b.id LIMIT p_limit
  )
  SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'items', COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(r)
      ORDER BY (r.familia_catalogo IS NULL) DESC, pg_catalog.lower(r.nome) COLLATE "C", r.id) FROM page r), '[]'::jsonb),
    'has_more', (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) > p_limit FROM bounded)
  ) INTO v_result;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.read_global_product_composition_core(p_produto_id uuid, p_limit integer, p_receita_offset integer)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_p public.produtos%ROWTYPE; v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM platform_private.catalog_metadata_require_actor();
  IF p_produto_id IS NULL OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit < 1 OR p_limit > 50 OR p_receita_offset IS NULL OR p_receita_offset < 0 OR p_receita_offset > 10000 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_invalid_query'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO v_p FROM public.produtos WHERE id = p_produto_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='42501', MESSAGE='catalog_composition_unavailable'; END IF;
  WITH rec AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT f.id AS formulacao_id, f.microrganismo_id, m.nome AS micro_nome, m.ativo AS micro_ativo, f.component_insumo_id,
           ip.nome AS insumo_nome, f.volume_ml, f.proporcao, f.concentracao, f.unidade, f.e_volume_fixo
    FROM public.formulacoes f JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = f.microrganismo_id
    LEFT JOIN public.produtos ip ON ip.id = f.component_insumo_id
    WHERE f.produto_id = p_produto_id ORDER BY f.created_at, f.id LIMIT p_limit + 1 OFFSET p_receita_offset
  ), dec AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d.id, d.ordem::int AS ordem, d.tipo_componente, d.microrganismo_id, m.nome AS micro_nome, m.ativo AS micro_ativo,
           d.componente_nome, d.quantidade, d.unidade, d.base, d.natureza
    FROM public.produto_composicao_declaracoes d LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = d.microrganismo_id
    WHERE d.produto_id = p_produto_id ORDER BY d.ordem LIMIT 51
  )
  SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object(
    'produto', pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('id',v_p.id,'nome',v_p.nome,'familia_catalogo',v_p.familia_catalogo,'updated_at',v_p.updated_at),
    'conjunto', (SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_build_object('status',c.status,'updated_at',c.updated_at)
                 FROM public.produto_composicao_conjuntos c WHERE c.produto_id = p_produto_id),
    'receita', COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(r)) FROM (SELECT * FROM rec LIMIT p_limit) r), '[]'::jsonb),
    'receita_offset', p_receita_offset,
    'declaracoes', COALESCE((SELECT pg_catalog.jsonb_agg(pg_catalog.to_jsonb(x) ORDER BY x.ordem) FROM (SELECT * FROM dec LIMIT 50) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'receita_has_more', (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) > p_limit FROM rec),
    'declaracoes_has_more', (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) > 50 FROM dec)) INTO v_result;
  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_catalogo_sync_mestre_preco(p_produto_id uuid, p_microrganismo_id uuid)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_litro numeric;
  v_tiers integer;
BEGIN
  IF num_nonnulls(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id) <> 1 THEN RETURN; END IF;

  SELECT litro, tiers INTO v_litro, v_tiers
  FROM public.fn_catalogo_litro_canonico(p_produto_id, p_microrganismo_id);

  IF COALESCE(v_tiers,0) = 0 THEN
    RETURN; -- sem apresentacao ativa: preserva fallback legado
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('arbio.catalogo_sync', 'on', true);

  IF p_produto_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
      UPDATE public.produtos p
         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2),
             valor_ha_brl    = CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.dose_ml_ha,0) > 0
                                    THEN round(v_litro * (p.dose_ml_ha / 1000.0), 2) END
       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id
         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
              OR p.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.produtos p
         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL, valor_ha_brl = NULL
       WHERE p.id = p_produto_id
         AND (p.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL OR p.valor_ha_brl IS NOT NULL);
    END IF;
  ELSE
    IF v_tiers = 1 AND COALESCE(v_litro,0) > 0 THEN
      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
         SET valor_litro_brl = v_litro,
             valor_dose_brl  = round(v_litro / 10.0, 2)
       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id
         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS DISTINCT FROM v_litro
              OR m.valor_dose_brl IS DISTINCT FROM round(v_litro / 10.0, 2));
    ELSE
      UPDATE public.microrganismos m
         SET valor_litro_brl = NULL, valor_dose_brl = NULL
       WHERE m.id = p_microrganismo_id
         AND (m.valor_litro_brl IS NOT NULL OR m.valor_dose_brl IS NOT NULL);
    END IF;
  END IF;

  PERFORM set_config('arbio.catalogo_sync', 'off', true);
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_comprovante_entrega_montar_v1(p_entrega_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  e            public.entregas%ROWTYPE;
  v_emitente   jsonb;
  v_destino    jsonb;
  v_os         jsonb;
  v_itens      jsonb;
  v_transporte jsonb;
  v_receb      jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();

  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_UNAUTHENTICATED' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NOT coalesce(public.is_delivery_staff(auth.uid()),false) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  SELECT * INTO e FROM public.entregas WHERE id = p_entrega_id;
  IF e.id IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'COMPROVANTE_ENTREGA_NAO_ENCONTRADA';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'razao_social', cs.legal_name,
           'nome_fantasia', cs.trade_name,
           'cnpj', cs.cnpj,
           'inscricao_estadual', cs.state_registration,
           'email', cs.fiscal_email,
           'telefone', cs.phone,
           'logradouro', cs.street,
           'numero', cs.number,
           'complemento', cs.complement,
           'bairro', cs.neighborhood,
           'cidade', cs.city,
           'uf', cs.state,
           'cep', cs.postal_code
         )
    INTO v_emitente
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.company_fiscal_settings WHERE organization_id = public.h15_actor_organization()) cs
   WHERE cs.is_active
   ORDER BY cs.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST
   LIMIT 1;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'cliente_id', c.id,
           'nome', coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.razao_social), ''), c.nome),
           'nome_fantasia', c.nome_fantasia,
           'cpf_cnpj', c.cpf_cnpj,
           'telefone', coalesce(nullif(btrim(c.telefone), ''), e.destinatario_telefone),
           'email', c.email,
           'cidade', coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.endereco_cidade), ''), c.endereco_municipio),
           'uf', coalesce(nullif(btrim(e.endereco_uf), ''), c.endereco_estado)
         )
    INTO v_destino
    FROM public.clientes c
   WHERE c.id = e.cliente_id;

  v_destino := coalesce(v_destino, '{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object(
    'destinatario_nome', e.destinatario_nome,
    'local_entrega', nullif(btrim(concat_ws(', ',
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_logradouro, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_numero, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_bairro, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_cidade, '')), ''),
        nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.endereco_uf, '')), ''))), '')
  );

  -- OS canonica: fluxo padrao (ordens_servico) ou fluxo On-Farm legitimo.
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
           'os_id', o.id,
           'numero_os', o.numero_os,
           'origem', coalesce(o.origem, 'manual'),
           'tipo', 'ordem_servico'
         )
    INTO v_os
    FROM public.ordens_servico o
   WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_id;

  IF v_os IS NULL AND e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
             'os_id', onf.id,
             'numero_os', onf.numero_os,
             'origem', 'on_farm',
             'tipo', 'ordem_servico_onfarm'
           )
      INTO v_os
      FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm onf
     WHERE onf.id = e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id;
  END IF;

  -- Origem legitima adicional mapeada no dominio: entrega vinculada a pedido
  -- de parceiro (B2B) sem OS de laboratorio. Documentado em
  -- docs/auditorias/comprovante-entrega-fase2.md.
  IF v_os IS NULL AND e.partner_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
             'os_id', po.id,
             'numero_os', po.numero,
             'origem', 'pedido_parceiro',
             'tipo', 'partner_order'
           )
      INTO v_os
      FROM public.partner_orders po
     WHERE po.id = e.partner_order_id;
  END IF;

  -- Itens: caminho canonico por etiqueta
  SELECT jsonb_agg(item ORDER BY item->>'lote')
    INTO v_itens
    FROM (
      SELECT jsonb_build_object(
               'produto', coalesce(pe.produto_nome, pr.nome),
               'microrganismo', coalesce(array_to_string(pe.cepas, ', '), m.nome_cientifico, m.nome),
               'lote', coalesce(pe.lote_codigo, l.codigo_lote),
               'fabricacao', coalesce(pe.fabricado_em::date, l.data_producao),
               'validade', pe.validade_em::date,
               'embalagem', coalesce(eb.tipo_embalagem, pe.unidade),
               'quantidade', coalesce(pe.quantidade_embalagens, 1),
               'volume_unitario_ml', pe.volume,
               'volume_total_ml', coalesce(pe.volume, 0) * coalesce(pe.quantidade_embalagens, 1)
             ) AS item
        FROM public.entrega_etiquetas ee
        JOIN public.produto_etiquetas pe ON pe.id = ee.etiqueta_id
        LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr ON pr.id = pe.produto_id
        LEFT JOIN public.lotes l ON l.id = pe.lote_id
        LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = l.microrganismo_id
        LEFT JOIN public.estoque_embalagens eb ON eb.id = pe.embalagem_id
       WHERE ee.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ee.ativo
    ) s;

  -- Fallback: vinculo direto da entrega (fluxo classico produto_id/lote_id).
  -- Referencias sempre por e2 (linha atual), sem depender da variavel PL/pgSQL.
  IF v_itens IS NULL OR jsonb_array_length(v_itens) = 0 THEN
    SELECT jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
             'produto', pr.nome,
             'microrganismo', coalesce(m.nome_cientifico, m.nome),
             'lote', l.codigo_lote,
             'fabricacao', l.data_producao,
             'validade', ep.validade,
             'embalagem', env.tipo_embalagem,
             'quantidade', e2.quantidade_entregue,
             'volume_unitario_ml', coalesce(
               env.volume_por_unidade,
               CASE WHEN coalesce(e2.quantidade_entregue, 0) > 0
                    THEN round(e2.volume_entregue_ml / e2.quantidade_entregue, 2) END),
             'volume_total_ml', coalesce(
               e2.volume_entregue_ml,
               env.volume_por_unidade * e2.quantidade_entregue)
           ))
      INTO v_itens
      FROM public.entregas e2
      LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr
             ON pr.id = coalesce(e2.produto_id,
                                 (SELECT l2.produto_id FROM public.lotes l2 WHERE l2.id = e2.lote_id))
      LEFT JOIN public.lotes l ON l.id = e2.lote_id
      LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = l.microrganismo_id
      LEFT JOIN public.estoque_produto ep ON ep.id = e2.estoque_produto_id
      LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT en.tipo_embalagem, en.volume_por_unidade
          FROM public.envase en
         WHERE en.lote_id = e2.lote_id
         ORDER BY en.data_envase DESC NULLS LAST
         LIMIT 1
      ) env ON true
     WHERE e2.id = p_entrega_id;
  END IF;

  v_transporte := jsonb_build_object(
    'modalidade', e.tipo_entrega,
    'motorista', e.motorista,
    'motorista_telefone', e.motorista_telefone,
    'veiculo', e.veiculo,
    'placa', e.veiculo_placa,
    'veiculo_tipo', e.veiculo_tipo,
    'data_saida', e.data_saida,
    'hora_saida_prevista', e.hora_saida_prevista
  );

  v_receb := jsonb_build_object(
    'recebido_por_nome', coalesce(nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.recebido_por_nome, '')), ''),
                                  nullif(btrim(coalesce(e.recebedor_nome, '')), '')),
    'documento', coalesce(e.recebido_por_documento, e.recebedor_documento),
    'cargo', coalesce(e.recebido_por_cargo, e.recebedor_cargo),
    'observacoes', e.observacoes_confirmacao,
    'confirmado_em', coalesce(e.confirmada_em, e.entregue_em, e.recebimento_confirmado_em),
    'confirmado_por', coalesce(e.confirmado_por, e.confirmada_por, e.recebimento_confirmado_por),
    'assinatura_tipo', e.assinatura_tipo
  );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'template_versao', 'comprovante-entrega-v1',
    'entrega_id', e.id,
    'entrega_status', e.status::text,
    'emitente', coalesce(v_emitente, '{}'::jsonb),
    'destinatario', coalesce(v_destino, '{}'::jsonb),
    'ordem_servico', v_os,
    'itens', coalesce(v_itens, '[]'::jsonb),
    'transporte', v_transporte,
    'recebimento', v_receb
  );
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_entrega_build_snapshot_v1(p_entrega_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'extensions'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sessao_invalida' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NOT coalesce(public.is_delivery_staff(auth.uid()), false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'sem_permissao' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
    'template_versao', 'termo-entrega-v1',
    'gerado_em', now(),
    'entrega', to_jsonb(e),
    'cliente', (SELECT to_jsonb(c) FROM public.clientes c WHERE c.id = e.cliente_id),
    'ordem_servico', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM public.ordens_servico o WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_id),
    'ordem_servico_onfarm', (SELECT to_jsonb(o) FROM public.ordens_servico_onfarm o WHERE o.id = e.ordem_servico_onfarm_id),

      'nome', e.recebedor_nome, 'documento', e.recebedor_documento,
      'cargo', e.recebedor_cargo, 'telefone', e.recebedor_telefone),
    'itens', coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
        'etiqueta', to_jsonb(pe),
        'embalagem', (SELECT to_jsonb(eb) FROM public.estoque_embalagens eb WHERE eb.id = pe.embalagem_id),
        'lote', (SELECT to_jsonb(l) FROM public.lotes l WHERE l.id = pe.lote_id),
        'produto', (SELECT to_jsonb(pr) FROM public.produtos pr WHERE pr.id = pe.produto_id),
        'conferencia', (SELECT to_jsonb(ci) FROM public.entrega_conferencia_itens ci
                        WHERE ci.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ci.etiqueta_id = pe.id)
      )) ORDER BY pe.id)
      FROM public.entrega_etiquetas ee
      JOIN public.produto_etiquetas pe ON pe.id = ee.etiqueta_id
      WHERE ee.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ee.ativo
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'checklist', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ck) ORDER BY ck.id)
                           FROM public.entrega_checklist ck WHERE ck.entrega_id = p_entrega_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'ocorrencias', coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(oc) ORDER BY oc.id)
                             FROM public.entrega_ocorrencias oc WHERE oc.entrega_id = p_entrega_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'divergencias', coalesce((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('etiqueta_id', ci.etiqueta_id, 'status', ci.status,
                                          'quantidade', ci.quantidade, 'motivo', ci.motivo) ORDER BY ci.id)
      FROM public.entrega_conferencia_itens ci
      WHERE ci.entrega_id = p_entrega_id AND ci.status <> 'aceito'), '[]'::jsonb)
  ))
  INTO v
  FROM public.entregas e
  WHERE e.id = p_entrega_id;

  IF v IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'entrega_nao_encontrada' USING ERRCODE = 'raise_exception';
  END IF;
  RETURN v;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_alerts(p_reference_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(alert_type text, severity text, title text, description text, amount numeric, count integer, action_key text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  -- 1 entregas sem faturamento
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'DELIVERIES_PENDING_BILLING'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Entregas confirmadas sem faturamento'::text,
         'Existem entregas concluídas que ainda não geraram conta a receber.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'entregas-nao-faturadas'::text
    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 2 recebimentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_RECEIVABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Recebimentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a receber em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'receber-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
   WHERE ari.due_date < p_reference_date AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 3 pagamentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_PAYABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Pagamentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a pagar em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'pagar-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
   WHERE api.due_date < p_reference_date AND api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 4 NF-e pendente
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'PENDING_FISCAL_INVOICE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'NF-e pendente'::text,
         'Contas a receber aguardando emissão de NF-e.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'nfe-pendente'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable
   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 5 categorias sem DRE
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'UNCLASSIFIED_DRE'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Categorias sem classificação DRE'::text,
         'Algumas categorias usadas em títulos não têm grupo DRE definido.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'categorias-dre'::text
    FROM financial_categories fc
   WHERE fc.dre_group IS NULL
     AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.category_id = fc.id)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable ap WHERE ap.category_id = fc.id))
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 6 recorrências com falha
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_FAILED'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências com falha'::text,
         'Erros recentes na geração automática de títulos recorrentes.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= (p_reference_date - INTERVAL '30 days')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 7 recorrências atrasadas
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_DUE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências atrasadas para geração'::text,
         'Modelos recorrentes ativos com geração pendente.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_financial_templates
   WHERE active = true AND auto_generate = true
     AND next_generation_date IS NOT NULL AND next_generation_date < p_reference_date
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 8 contas sem centro de custo
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'MISSING_COST_CENTER'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Contas sem centro de custo'::text,
         'Títulos financeiros sem centro de custo associado.'::text,
         0::numeric,
         ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
        + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED'))::int,
         'centros-custo'::text
   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_dashboard_summary(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_cost_center_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r jsonb;
  v_rec_expected numeric := 0; v_rec_received numeric := 0;
  v_rec_open numeric := 0; v_rec_overdue numeric := 0; v_rec_partial numeric := 0;
  v_rec_overdue_count int := 0; v_rec_avg_days int := 0;
  v_pay_expected numeric := 0; v_pay_paid numeric := 0;
  v_pay_open numeric := 0; v_pay_overdue numeric := 0; v_pay_partial numeric := 0;
  v_pay_overdue_count int := 0;
  v_nfe_count int := 0; v_nfe_amount numeric := 0;
  v_deliv_count int := 0; v_deliv_amount numeric := 0;
  v_rec_recurring numeric := 0; v_pay_recurring numeric := 0;
  v_rec_errors int := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periodo invalido: informe datas inicial e final em ordem.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- A receber (previsto: pelo vencimento no período)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)::int,
         COALESCE(AVG((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - ari.due_date)
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0)::int
    INTO v_rec_expected, v_rec_open, v_rec_overdue, v_rec_partial, v_rec_overdue_count, v_rec_avg_days
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
   WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A receber (realizado: por payment_date)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0)
    INTO v_rec_received
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
   WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A pagar (previsto)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)::int
    INTO v_pay_expected, v_pay_open, v_pay_overdue, v_pay_partial, v_pay_overdue_count
    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
   WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A pagar (realizado)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount_paid),0)
    INTO v_pay_paid
    FROM payable_payments pp
    JOIN accounts_payable_installments api ON api.id = pp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
   WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- NF-e pendente
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)
    INTO v_nfe_count, v_nfe_amount
    FROM accounts_receivable
   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true
     AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING';

  -- Entregas pendentes faturamento
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)
    INTO v_deliv_count, v_deliv_amount
    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL;

  -- Recorrências ativas
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='RECEIVABLE'),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='PAYABLE'),0)
    INTO v_rec_recurring, v_pay_recurring
    FROM recurring_financial_templates
   WHERE active = true;

  SELECT COUNT(*)::int INTO v_rec_errors
    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= ((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - INTERVAL '30 days');

  r := jsonb_build_object(
    'total_receivable_expected', v_rec_expected,
    'total_receivable_received', v_rec_received,
    'total_receivable_open', v_rec_open,
    'total_receivable_overdue', v_rec_overdue,
    'total_receivable_partial', v_rec_partial,
    'overdue_receivables_count', v_rec_overdue_count,
    'average_days_overdue', v_rec_avg_days,
    'total_payable_expected', v_pay_expected,
    'total_payable_paid', v_pay_paid,
    'total_payable_open', v_pay_open,
    'total_payable_overdue', v_pay_overdue,
    'total_payable_partial', v_pay_partial,
    'overdue_payables_count', v_pay_overdue_count,
    'projected_balance', v_rec_expected - v_pay_expected,
    'realized_balance', v_rec_received - v_pay_paid,
    'collection_rate', CASE WHEN v_rec_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_rec_received / v_rec_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'payment_rate', CASE WHEN v_pay_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_pay_paid / v_pay_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'pending_fiscal_invoice_count', v_nfe_count,
    'pending_fiscal_invoice_amount', v_nfe_amount,
    'pending_billing_deliveries_count', v_deliv_count,
    'pending_billing_deliveries_amount', v_deliv_amount,
    'active_recurring_receivables_amount', v_rec_recurring,
    'active_recurring_payables_amount', v_pay_recurring,
    'recurring_net_balance', v_rec_recurring - v_pay_recurring,
    'recurring_generation_errors_count', v_rec_errors
  );
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_partner_catalog_secure(p_partner_id uuid, p_catalog_v2 boolean)
 RETURNS TABLE(item_id uuid, item_tipo text, product_id uuid, produto_nome text, produto_codigo text, descricao_curta text, preco_tabela numeric, desconto_percentual numeric, preco_parceiro numeric, produto_ativo boolean, resumo_curto text, explicacao_b2b text, beneficios_principais text, ficha_status text, ficha_aprovada boolean, valor_dose_brl numeric, valor_litro_brl numeric, valor_ha_brl numeric, unidade_preco_principal text, familia_catalogo text, catalog_contract text, ficha_conteudo jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF p_catalog_v2 IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_contract_required' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY SELECT r.*, CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='microrganismo' THEN 'biologico'::text ELSE p.familia_catalogo END, 'C1B_DUAL_TENANT_V1'::text,
 CASE WHEN r.ficha_aprovada IS TRUE THEN jsonb_build_object(
  'subtitulo', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.tipo::text ELSE m.nome_cientifico END,
  'funcao', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.funcao_completa ELSE m.funcao_agronomica END,
  'dose_ml_ha', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN p.dose_ml_ha ELSE m.dose_ml_ha END,
  'explicacao_produtor', COALESCE(pp.explicacao_produtor,mp.explicacao_produtor),
  'indicacoes_uso', COALESCE(pp.indicacoes_uso,mp.indicacoes_uso),
  'cuidados_aplicacao', COALESCE(pp.cuidados_aplicacao,mp.cuidados_aplicacao),
  'mecanismo_acao', mp.mecanismo_acao,
  'alvos_count', CASE WHEN r.item_tipo='produto' THEN
    (SELECT count(*) FROM public.product_target_recommendations t WHERE t.produto_id=r.item_id AND t.ativo IS TRUE)
    ELSE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.microorganism_targets t WHERE t.microrganismo_id=r.item_id AND t.ativo IS TRUE) END,
  'fontes_count', (SELECT count(*) FROM public.catalog_technical_sources cs WHERE cs.entidade_id=r.item_id
    AND cs.entidade_tipo IN (r.item_tipo, 'ficha_' || r.item_tipo))
 ) ELSE '{}'::jsonb END
 FROM public.get_partner_catalog_secure(p_partner_id) r
 LEFT JOIN public.produtos p ON r.item_tipo='produto' AND p.id=r.item_id
 LEFT JOIN public.microrganismos m ON r.item_tipo='microrganismo' AND m.id=r.item_id
 LEFT JOIN public.product_technical_profiles pp ON r.item_tipo='produto' AND pp.produto_id=r.item_id AND pp.status_validacao='aprovado'
 LEFT JOIN public.microorganism_technical_profiles mp ON r.item_tipo='microrganismo' AND mp.microrganismo_id=r.item_id AND mp.status_validacao='aprovado';
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_portal_cliente_b2b_order_detail_secure(p_order_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_order public.partner_orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authenticated';
  END IF;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_production_planning_detail(p_planning_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_result jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(v_uid,'administrador') OR public.has_role(v_uid,'gestor_comercial')
       OR public.has_role(v_uid,'producao') OR public.has_role(v_uid,'gestor')) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'unauthorized';
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'planning', to_jsonb(pp.*),
    'partner', to_jsonb(pa.*),
    'order', to_jsonb(po.*),
    'items', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', poi.id,
        'product_id', poi.product_id,
        'produto_nome', COALESCE(poi.produto_nome_snapshot, pr.nome),
        'codigo', COALESCE(poi.produto_codigo_snapshot, pr.codigo),
        'produto_tipo', pr.tipo,
        'quantidade', poi.quantidade,
        'unidade_medida', COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade'),
        'dose_ml_ha', pr.dose_ml_ha,
        'modo_aplicacao', pr.modo_aplicacao,
        -- Lista completa de microrganismos (suporta consórcios)
        'microrganismos', COALESCE((
          SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
            'id', m.id,
            'nome', m.nome,
            'codigo', m.codigo,
            'tipo', m.tipo,
            'concentracao', f.concentracao,
            'concentracao_unidade', f.unidade
          ) ORDER BY m.nome)
          FROM public.formulacoes f
          JOIN public.microrganismos m ON m.id = f.microrganismo_id
          WHERE f.produto_id = poi.product_id
        ), CASE WHEN poi.microrganismo_id IS NOT NULL THEN
            (SELECT jsonb_build_array(jsonb_build_object(
                'id', m2.id, 'nome', m2.nome, 'codigo', m2.codigo, 'tipo', m2.tipo,
                'concentracao', NULL, 'concentracao_unidade', NULL))
             FROM public.microrganismos m2 WHERE m2.id = poi.microrganismo_id)
           ELSE '[]'::jsonb END),
        'vasilhame_volume_ml', cv.volume_ml,
        'vasilhame_rotulo', cv.rotulo,
        'volume_unitario_l', CASE
                               WHEN cv.volume_ml IS NOT NULL THEN cv.volume_ml / 1000.0
                               WHEN COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'litro' THEN 1
                               WHEN COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'ml' THEN 1/1000.0
                               ELSE NULL END,
        'volume_total_l', CASE
                            WHEN cv.volume_ml IS NOT NULL THEN (cv.volume_ml * poi.quantidade) / 1000.0
                            WHEN COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'litro' THEN poi.quantidade
                            WHEN COALESCE(poi.unidade_medida,'unidade') = 'ml' THEN poi.quantidade / 1000.0
                            ELSE NULL END,
        'qtd_vasilhames', poi.quantidade,
        'os_id', (SELECT l.ordem_servico_id FROM public.production_order_link l WHERE l.partner_order_item_id = poi.id),
        'os_numero', (SELECT os.numero_os FROM public.production_order_link l JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id = l.ordem_servico_id WHERE l.partner_order_item_id = poi.id),
        'os_status', (SELECT os.status FROM public.production_order_link l JOIN public.ordens_servico os ON os.id = l.ordem_servico_id WHERE l.partner_order_item_id = poi.id)
      )) FROM public.partner_order_items poi
        LEFT JOIN public.produtos pr ON pr.id = poi.product_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT cv2.volume_ml, cv2.rotulo
            FROM public.catalogo_volumes cv2
           WHERE cv2.item_tipo = 'produto'
             AND cv2.produto_id = poi.product_id
             AND cv2.ativo = true
           ORDER BY
             (cv2.preco_brl = COALESCE(poi.preco_tabela_snapshot, poi.preco_unitario)) DESC,
             ABS(cv2.preco_brl - COALESCE(poi.preco_tabela_snapshot, poi.preco_unitario)) ASC
           LIMIT 1
        ) cv ON true
        WHERE poi.order_id = po.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'timeline', COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t.*) ORDER BY t.event_at)
        FROM public.production_timeline_events t WHERE t.partner_order_id = po.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    'has_orders', EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.production_order_link WHERE planning_id = pp.id)
  ) INTO v_result
  FROM public.production_planning pp
  JOIN public.partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = pp.partner_id
  JOIN public.partner_orders po ON po.id = pp.partner_order_id
  WHERE pp.id = p_planning_id;

  RETURN v_result;
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_executive_dashboard()
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb; kpis jsonb; fc jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  kpis := rpc_b2b_carteira_kpis(NULL,NULL);
  fc := rpc_b2b_revenue_forecast(NULL);

  WITH topp AS (
    SELECT pa.id, COALESCE(pa.nome_fantasia,pa.razao_social) AS nome, COALESCE(SUM(po.total),0) AS total
    FROM partner_orders po
    JOIN partner_accounts pa ON pa.id = po.partner_id
    WHERE po.status NOT IN ('cancelado','reprovado','rascunho')
      AND po.created_at >= date_trunc('year',now())
    GROUP BY pa.id, pa.nome_fantasia, pa.razao_social
    ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
  ),
  topprod AS (
    SELECT pr.id, pr.nome, COALESCE(SUM(poi.subtotal),0) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(poi.quantidade),0) AS qtd
    FROM partner_order_items poi
    JOIN partner_orders po ON po.id = poi.order_id
    JOIN produtos pr ON pr.id = poi.product_id
    WHERE po.status NOT IN ('cancelado','reprovado','rascunho')
      AND po.created_at >= date_trunc('year',now())
    GROUP BY pr.id, pr.nome
    ORDER BY total DESC LIMIT 10
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'kpis', kpis,
    'forecast', fc,
    'parceiros_ativos', (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM partner_accounts WHERE ativo=true AND deleted_at IS NULL),
    'parceiros_bloqueados', (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT partner_id) FROM partner_orders WHERE status='aguardando_aprovacao_credito'),
    'score_medio', (SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(score),2),0) FROM partner_risk_scores),
    'top_parceiros', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('partner_id',id,'nome',nome,'total',total)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM topp),
    'top_produtos', (SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('produto_id',id,'nome',nome,'total',total,'quantidade',qtd)),'[]'::jsonb) FROM topprod)
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_cc_validate_matrix(p_plan_id uuid, p_buyer_scope text, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_missing jsonb; v_drafts int; v_quote int;
BEGIN
 IF NOT platform_private.c2p1_assignment_allowed(p_buyer_scope,p_partner_id,p_customer_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'C2P1_FORBIDDEN' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
  IF NOT public.fn_cc_can_prepare(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_authorized'; END IF;
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('tipo',tipo,'id',id,'nome',nome)),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_missing
  FROM (
    SELECT 'produto' tipo, p.id, p.nome FROM public.produtos p
     WHERE COALESCE(p.ativo,true)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i
            WHERE platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(i.assignment_id,i.plan_id,i.buyer_scope,i.partner_id,i.customer_id) AND i.plan_id=p_plan_id AND i.product_id=p.id AND i.buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
              AND i.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
              AND i.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id
              AND i.status IN ('draft','pending_approval','published'))
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'microrganismo', m.id, m.nome FROM public.microrganismos m
     WHERE COALESCE(m.ativo,true)
       AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices i
            WHERE platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(i.assignment_id,i.plan_id,i.buyer_scope,i.partner_id,i.customer_id) AND i.plan_id=p_plan_id AND i.microrganismo_id=m.id AND i.buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
              AND i.partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
              AND i.customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id
              AND i.status IN ('draft','pending_approval','published'))
  ) s;
  SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='draft'), count(*) FILTER (WHERE pricing_mode='quote_only')
    INTO v_drafts, v_quote
  FROM public.commercial_condition_item_prices
   WHERE platform_private.c2p1_item_allowed(assignment_id,plan_id,buyer_scope,partner_id,customer_id) AND plan_id=p_plan_id AND buyer_scope=p_buyer_scope
     AND partner_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_partner_id
     AND customer_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM p_customer_id;
  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', jsonb_array_length(v_missing)=0,
    'missing_items', v_missing, 'draft_count', COALESCE(v_drafts,0), 'quote_only_count', COALESCE(v_quote,0));
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_microorganism_regulatory_overview()

    SELECT jsonb_build_object(
      'microorganism_id', m.id,
      'codigo', m.codigo,
      'nome', m.nome,
      'tipo', m.tipo,
      'ativo', m.ativo,
      'concentracao_label', m.concentracao_label,
      'facts', f.facts,
      'checklist_total', coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_total')::int, 0),
      'checklist_confirmed', coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_confirmed')::int, 0),
      'checklist_pending', coalesce(jsonb_array_length(coalesce(f.facts->'checklist_pending','[]'::jsonb)),0),
      'progress_pct', CASE WHEN coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_total')::int,0) = 0 THEN 0
                           ELSE round(100.0 * (coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_total')::int,0)
                                - jsonb_array_length(coalesce(f.facts->'checklist_pending','[]'::jsonb)))
                                / coalesce((f.facts->>'checklist_total')::int,1)) END,
      'dossier_status', coalesce(f.facts->>'status','NONE'),
      'profile_status', r.profile_status,
      'fiscally_ready', coalesce(r.fiscally_ready,false),
      'technical_ready', coalesce(r.minimally_classified,false),
      'regulatory_ready', coalesce(r.regulatory_ready,false),
      'quarantined', coalesce(r.quarantined,false),
      'pendencies', coalesce(r.pendencies,'[]'::jsonb),
      'not_applicable', coalesce(r.not_applicable,'[]'::jsonb)) AS x
    FROM public.microrganismos m
    LEFT JOIN public.v_microorganism_fiscal_readiness r ON r.microorganism_id = m.id
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL (SELECT public.fn_microorganism_regulatory_facts(m.id) AS facts) f
    WHERE m.ativo
  ) s;
  RETURN v;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_partner_commercial_history(p_partner_id uuid, p_from date DEFAULT ((now())::date - 365), p_to date DEFAULT (now())::date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb; top jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (
    public.has_role(auth.uid(),'administrador')
    OR public.has_role(auth.uid(),'gestor_comercial')
    OR (public.has_role(auth.uid(),'parceiro_b2b') AND public.get_user_partner_id() = p_partner_id)
  ) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'forbidden';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t), '[]'::jsonb) INTO top FROM (
    SELECT poi.produto_nome_snapshot AS produto,
           SUM(poi.quantidade) AS quantidade,
           SUM(poi.subtotal) AS valor
    FROM public.partner_order_items poi
    JOIN public.partner_orders po ON po.id = poi.order_id
    WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
      AND po.created_at::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to
    GROUP BY poi.produto_nome_snapshot
    ORDER BY SUM(poi.subtotal) DESC
    LIMIT 10
  ) t;

  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'qtd_pedidos', COUNT(*),
    'valor_acumulado', COALESCE(SUM(total),0),
    'ticket_medio', COALESCE(AVG(total),0),
    'ultima_compra', MAX(created_at),
    'top_produtos', top
  ) INTO r
  FROM public.partner_orders
  WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND created_at::date BETWEEN p_from AND p_to;
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.tenant_catalog_visit_selection_page(p_registro_id uuid, p_entity_type text, p_search text, p_limit integer, p_offset integer, p_include_ids uuid[])
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, nome text, familia_catalogo text, selectable boolean, in_page boolean, total bigint)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid; v_q text:=NULLIF(btrim(p_search),'');
BEGIN
 v_org:=platform_private.catalog_tenant_actor('read_prefs');
 IF NOT COALESCE(public.can_view_technical_visit(auth.uid(),p_registro_id),false) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'sem_permissao' USING ERRCODE='42501'; END IF;
 IF p_entity_type IS NULL OR p_entity_type NOT IN ('produto','microrganismo')
 OR p_limit IS NULL OR p_limit NOT BETWEEN 1 AND 100 OR p_offset IS NULL OR p_offset NOT BETWEEN 0 AND 100000
 OR char_length(v_q)>80 OR cardinality(p_include_ids)>50 OR array_position(p_include_ids,NULL) IS NOT NULL THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'catalog_visibility_invalid_payload' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 RETURN QUERY WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id,p.nome::text,p.familia_catalogo::text,p.ativo FROM public.produtos p
   WHERE p_entity_type='produto' AND to_jsonb(p)->>'owner_organization_id' IS NULL
  UNION ALL SELECT m.id,m.nome::text,'microrganismo'::text,m.ativo FROM public.microrganismos m
   WHERE p_entity_type='microrganismo' AND to_jsonb(m)->>'owner_organization_id' IS NULL
 ), marked AS (
  SELECT b.*, b.ativo IS TRUE AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.catalog_tenant_visibility v
   WHERE v.organization_id=v_org AND v.entity_type=p_entity_type AND v.hidden
    AND COALESCE(v.produto_id,v.microrganismo_id)=b.id) AS eligible FROM base b
 ), page AS (
  SELECT m.*,count(*) OVER() AS total FROM marked m WHERE m.eligible
   AND (v_q IS NULL OR m.nome ILIKE '%'||replace(replace(replace(v_q,'\','\\'),'%','\%'),'_','\_')||'%')
   ORDER BY m.nome,m.id LIMIT p_limit OFFSET p_offset
 ) SELECT p.id,p.nome,p.familia_catalogo,p.eligible,true,p.total FROM page p
 UNION ALL SELECT m.id,m.nome,m.familia_catalogo,m.eligible,false,NULL::bigint FROM marked m
  WHERE m.id=ANY(p_include_ids) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM page p WHERE p.id=m.id)
    AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.registros_consultor_recomendacoes r WHERE r.registro_consultor_id=p_registro_id
      AND CASE WHEN p_entity_type='produto' THEN r.produto_biologico_sugerido_id ELSE r.microrganismo_id END=m.id);
END $function$
